title: No Game No Life Mini OVAs
justification: AniList 20769 has 6 Mini OVAs (2014-06-25 to 2014-11-26). AniDB 9998 S1-S6 'Mini OVA: Mousou "Wild Fancy"', 'Kantoku "Director"', 'Fukushuu "Revenge"', 'Ningyou "Dress-up Doll"', 'Seichou "Growth"', 'Shokuyoku "A Pair Tight"' (English 'Short 1..6') on 2014-06-25, 07-30, 08-27, 09-24, 10-29, 11-26. TVDB 278155 0x01-0x06 are 'Special 1 - Wild Fancy' ... 'Special 6 - A Pair Tight' on the same dates; TMDB tv/60808 S0E1-6 likewise. S7-S12 (Noge Cup live-action) are unmapped by the parent's rows.
